title: create_app inputSchema
description: Argument shape for create_app (Build App; returns an App). Composes an SDK-native application from a Map, artifacts, and an app template. V1 targets honua-sdk-js with MapLibre GL JS. Responsibility-level: the App authoring field set finalizes upstream (honua-server#731). See taxonomy.md §App composition and resources.md §honua://app-packages/{app_package_id}.

targetSdk.description: Target SDK declaration. V1 default is honua-sdk-js.

runtimeConfig.description: Runtime configuration values projected into the generated app.
